svg.aria-label: Several times: a super Yang-Mills theory built in Nishino's manner lives only on the lines s - t = 8, 0, -8, so none exists in (9+8n)+1, (10+8n)+2, (11+8n)+3, (12+8n)+4 for n >= 1; 2(d-2) is a multiple of the Weyl dimension only at d = 3, 4, 6, 10; for one time every massless multiplet without tensor charges in (9+8n)+1 has at least 2^(2^(2+4n)) states

svg.text: Super Yang–Mills built in Nishino's manner: k real null vectors, k ≤ min(s, t), and a residual dimension s + t − 2k that must be 10 (or 2).
